FIREFate
========

**FIREFate** (Functional and Interpretable Regulatory Encoding of Fate determination) is a
framework that uses interpretable machine learning to focus dense mechanistic gene regulatory
networks (GRNs) onto the components that govern cell fate decisions.

This site hosts the user guide and Python API reference for the ``firefate`` package.

.. grid:: 2

   .. grid-item-card:: Install
      :link: installation
      :link-type: doc
